articles.event_key: 以色列|越过黄线在加沙中部完成地面行动|加沙黄线/哈马斯控制区
articles.title: 以军称完成加沙中部黄线以外地面行动，哈马斯指违反停火
articles.summary: 以军称完成加沙中部黄线以西罕见地面行动，目标拆除“恐怖隧道”；哈马斯指其公然违反停火协议，其管理机构称约6000人逃离。
articles.new_facts: 以军称完成加沙中部黄线以西罕见地面行动；以军称目标拆除“恐怖隧道”；行动18日引发撤离，19日结束并重开萨拉丁轴线；哈马斯指违反停火协议；哈马斯管理机构称约6000人逃离。

facts.text: 以色列军方称，以军已完成在加沙中部黄线以外部分地区的一次罕见地面行动。

evidence.quote: Israeli forces have completed a rare ground operation in part of central Gaza outside their control, the military says

facts.text: 以军称行动目标是拆除黄线以西一条“恐怖隧道”；行动18日引发居民撤离，19日早上结束，萨拉丁轴线重新开放。

evidence.quote: The Israeli military said the "targeted" operation aimed to dismantle a "terror tunnel" west of the so-called Yellow Line
the activity has ended, and the Salah al-Din axis has been reopened

facts.text: 哈马斯称以军越线和居民撤离是对2025年10月停火协议的“公然违反”；哈马斯管理的政府媒体办公室称约6000人逃离，并称这构成强制迁移。

evidence.quote: accused Israel of a "flagrant violation" of the October 2025 ceasefire deal
an estimated 6,000 people had fled their homes and tents because of the operation

articles.limitations: 以军行动、隧道目标和平民撤离说法主要来自以军及哈马斯方面，BBC报道未获独立现场核实；6000人为哈马斯管理机构的估计。

bilingual.title_en: Israeli Military Says It Completed Ground Operation Beyond Yellow Line in Central Gaza; Hamas Calls It a Ceasefire Violation

sentences.en: The Israeli military said its forces have completed a rare ground operation in some areas beyond the Yellow Line in central Gaza.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方称，以军已完成在加沙中部黄线以外部分地区的一次罕见地面行动。

sentences.en: The Israeli military said the operation aimed to dismantle a "terror tunnel" west of the Yellow Line; the operation prompted residents to evacuate on the 18th and ended on the morning of the 19th, when the Salah al-Din axis was reopened.
sentences.zh: 以军称行动目标是拆除黄线以西一条“恐怖隧道”；行动18日引发居民撤离，19日早上结束，萨拉丁轴线重新开放。

sentences.en: Hamas said the Israeli military's crossing of the line and the evacuation of residents constituted a "blatant violation" of the October 2025 ceasefire agreement; the Hamas-run government media office said about 6,000 people fled and described this as forced displacement.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯称以军越线和居民撤离是对2025年10月停火协议的“公然违反”；哈马斯管理的政府媒体办公室称约6000人逃离，并称这构成强制迁移。

articles.event_key: 国际法院|裁定缅甸对罗兴亚人实施种族灭绝|冈比亚诉缅甸案
articles.title: 国际法院裁定缅甸对罗兴亚人实施种族灭绝
articles.summary: 国际法院19日首次裁定一个国家犯种族灭绝罪，认定缅甸对罗兴亚人实施种族灭绝，以9比6通过；缅甸否认相关指控。
articles.new_facts: 国际法院裁定缅甸对罗兴亚人实施种族灭绝；这是国际法院首次认定国家犯种族灭绝罪；9比6通过；法院认定约1万人被杀、超70万人逃亡；缅甸否认。

facts.text: 国际法院19日裁定缅甸对罗兴亚人实施种族灭绝，这是国际法院首次认定一个国家犯下种族灭绝罪。

evidence.quote: Myanmar has been found guilty of committing genocide against its Rohingya minority by the International Court of Justice (ICJ).
The verdict marks the first time a state has ever been found to have committed genocide by an international court.

facts.text: 法院以9票对6票作出裁决，认定2017年“清剿行动”中约1万名罗兴亚人被暴力杀害，超过70万人逃往孟加拉国，约81.5万人成为目标。

evidence.quote: The verdict was reached by a majority of nine votes to six among a panel of judges from around the world.
The ICJ determined that around 10,000 Rohingya were "violently killed" during the clearance operation, while more than 700,000 are thought to have fled to Bangladesh
approximately 815,000 had been targeted in some way

facts.text: 法院称，从证据中只能合理推断出种族灭绝意图，并认定缅甸存在大规模毁坏证据等行为；缅甸一直否认种族灭绝，称其行动针对武装威胁。

evidence.quote: genocidal intent is the only reasonable inference that can be drawn from the evidence
Myanmar consistently denied genocide against the Rohingya, saying its operations had targeted militant or insurgent threats

facts.text: 法院还认定缅甸有义务支付成比例赔偿，具体金额日后确定。

evidence.quote: Myanmar had an obligation to pay proportionate reparations, but said an exact figure could be determined at a later date.

articles.limitations: 判决细节来自BBC对国际法院裁决的报道，输入未附法院判决全文；缅甸方面的否认已注明。

bilingual.title_en: ICJ rules Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya

sentences.en: The International Court of Justice ruled on the 19th that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, the first time the court has found a state guilty of genocide.
sentences.zh: 国际法院19日裁定缅甸对罗兴亚人实施种族灭绝，这是国际法院首次认定一个国家犯下种族灭绝罪。

sentences.en: The court ruled by 9 votes to 6, finding that about 10,000 Rohingya were violently killed during the 2017 "clearance operations," more than 700,000 fled to Bangladesh and about 815,000 were targeted.
sentences.zh: 法院以9票对6票作出裁决，认定2017年“清剿行动”中约1万名罗兴亚人被暴力杀害，超过70万人逃往孟加拉国，约81.5万人成为目标。

sentences.en: The court said the only reasonable inference from the evidence was genocidal intent, and found that Myanmar had engaged in acts including the large-scale destruction of evidence; Myanmar has consistently denied genocide, saying its operations targeted armed threats.
sentences.zh: 法院称，从证据中只能合理推断出种族灭绝意图，并认定缅甸存在大规模毁坏证据等行为；缅甸一直否认种族灭绝，称其行动针对武装威胁。

sentences.en: The court also found that Myanmar is obliged to pay proportionate reparations, with the specific amount to be determined later.
sentences.zh: 法院还认定缅甸有义务支付成比例赔偿，具体金额日后确定。
